name: E1_naive_N40_SELEX_library
use: naive CE-SELEX / bead-SELEX round 1 for either target; same arms as the published NPY selection so the workflow and the resulting sensor stay directly comparable
scale: 1 umol, desalted; ~10^14-10^15 unique molecules in a typical 1 nmol input aliquot

name: E2_doped_4.31_NPY_maturation
use: affinity/switch maturation of the existing NPY binder; run with increasing stringency + PP and PYY counter-selection

name: E3_doped_4.31_PP_retargeting
spec: 5'-AGCAGCACAGAGGTCAGATG-[CAAACCACAGCCTGAGTGGTTAGCGTATGTCATTTACGGA @ 30% doping]-CCTATGCGTGCTACCGTGAA-3'  BUT core positions [24, 25, 26, 39, 40] (1-based in the core; construct positions 44,45,46,59,60) doped at only 5% - they base pair into the 5' fixed arm
use: re-target the 4.31 backbone to PP; counter-select against NPY and PYY in EVERY round from round 1 - this is the step that inverts the 42-fold NPY preference. Two doping levels in one oligo: a flat 30% destroyed the 5'arm<->core duplex in a quarter of candidates, and the orthogonal contact-probability run puts ~1/3 of the predicted interface on that arm

name: E4_primers
spec: FWD 5'-AGCAGCACAGAGGTCAGATG-3'  /  REV 5'-CCTATGCGTGCTACCGTGAA-3' (order the reverse primer 5'-phosphorylated or poly-A-tailed for ssDNA regeneration)
